title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（野口啓介研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Noguchi Keisuke)
educationalGoal:
Educational programs focusing on basic knowledge and skills in the fields of electrical engineering and electronics.
Students will:
(1) learn small antennas and wave propagation for mobile communication systems. (2) learn how to investigate each project theme. (3) learn objectives, research process, plan to annual schedule, research method and presentation of project. (4) achieve outcomes based on conventional research for project.
advice:
This course is the last subject in the design project, and it is positioned as a course which integrates the matters learned in all courses. Students will be encouraged to review basic courses and acquire advanced specialized knowledge through experiments and theoretical examinations through the project.

Each student has a project theme and works independently or as a group. Weekly meetings are held, and activities are reported in weekly reports. Annual schedule is as follows:

First semester :  Students will decide the project themes to be implemented and submit project proposals. Progress of activities is announced at an interim presentation held at the end of the semester.
Second semester : At the end of the semester, results of the activities are summarized to a project report. Based on the report, students will have a presentation at the final review in an open presentation meeting. After the open presentation meeting, students will have meetings with the next year's students to handover.

Project themes includes (1) small and planar antennas, (2) broadband and high efficient microstrip antennas, (3) antennas for sensor network systems, (4) wearable antennas, (5) automotive antennas and (6) wireless power transfer antennas.
requiredKnowledge:
1. Students should focus on the following steps: (1) what is the problem, (2) what is the cause of the problem, (3) how many solutions and what each one is, (4) what is the optimal solution.
2. To brush up solving ability for problems, students should have meetings and discussions with faculty, senior members and classmates.
3. Students will be encouraged to positively use laboratory facilities, library center and Yumekobo.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clarify the purpose of the project, to grasp the contents and plan research schedule.
Be able to find the solutions of the problem in the project theme and execute it safely and continuously.
Be able to analyze and evaluate the research results from the viewpoint of social needs.
Be able to discuss in a team and to make an effective presentation on research results.
Be able to summarize the research results as a project report

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the purpose of the project and plan detailed research annual schedule.
(2) Explain enough the objectives and the plan with easy-to-understand manner.
(3) Summarize the results of project activity, and publish the report as a research paper.
(4) Participate to academic meetings, have presentations, and receive effective evaluations.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the purpose of the project and plan research annual schedule.
(2) Explain enough the objectives and the plan.
(3) Summarize the results of project activity and present the contents at the open presentation meeting.
